run_multiprocessing_bpe_encoder: run the multiprocessing BPE encoder script to encode raw text files with GPT-2 BPE using multiple processes
encode_text_lines: encode text lines into GPT-2 BPE token IDs using the MultiprocessingEncoder class
decode_bpe_tokens: decode GPT-2 BPE token IDs back into readable text using the decode method
filter_empty_lines: filter empty lines during BPE encoding with the keep_empty flag in MultiprocessingEncoder
encode_multiple_files: encode multiple input files in parallel to corresponding output files using the multiprocessing BPE encoder
